highlights.degree: Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech)

overview: Studying Aerospace Engineering - PG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: What are the tuition fees for Aerospace Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees range from €10,000 to €17,000 (around ₹10.86 lakh to ₹18.46 lakh). Finnish universities offer competitive 50% to 100% merit scholarships for international students.

faq.question: How can Edu-Hawk Worldwide help with admission?
faq.answer: Edu-Hawk Worldwide provides end-to-end guidance: university shortlisting, eligibility evaluation, document verification, SOP reviews, Studyinfo.fi portal application, scholarship applications, and Finnish student residence permit guidance.
